Laneway Festival Melbourne acknowledges the Wurundjeri people as the traditional owners of the Country where we come together to work, learn, dance, and sing.
We recognise all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders continued connection to land, waters, culture, community and storytelling; and pay our respects to Elders past and present, and acknowledge that this always was and always will be, Aboriginal Land.
